fields.name: ShardParameterValue
fields.description: A mutable carrier pairing a shard identifier with a caller-supplied parameter name and payload. It is also the entry shape ShardsValues yields when enumerated or copied: a shard without named values is represented by one placeholder entry whose ParameterName and ParameterValue are null, while a shard with named values produces one entry per name/value mapping.

members.name: ShardId
members.description: The 16-bit shard identifier; parameterless construction sets it to 0.

members.name: ParameterName
members.description: The caller-supplied parameter name; parameterless construction sets it to null, and a ShardsValues placeholder entry carries null.
members.notes: C# representation: string; the source declares no length constraint.

members.name: ParameterValue
members.description: The caller-supplied payload; parameterless construction sets it to null, and a ShardsValues placeholder entry carries null.
members.notes: C# representation: object; the source does not specify a persisted or serialized representation.

representations.CSharp: public mutable properties: short ShardId, string ParameterName, object ParameterValue. Yielded by ShardsValues' IEnumerable<ShardParameterValue> implementation.
